arguments: THE ZEUS STATUE OF PHIDIAS IN OLYMPIA

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Every fourth summer, a huge festival was held in Olympia. For the duration of the festival, the area around the Kronos Hill in the Holy Grove was peaceful ... But would we be able to resurrect the Zeus Statue of Phidias? There was a lot of mistrust among the cities.
